definitions.short: Shephatjah , the name of ten Israelites
definitions.full: H8203. Shephatyah or Shephatyahu שְׁפַטְיָה(וּׅ proper name, masculine ( ׳י judged, vindicated ); — usu, Σαφατια ( ς ): 1 יָה -: a. fifth son of David 2Sam 3:4 = 1Chr 3:3 ( Σαβατεια , A Σαφαθια , ᵐ5 L Σαφατιας ). b. contemporary of Jeremiah Jer 38:1 (B Σαφανιας ). c. man of Judah Neh 11:4 . d. chiefs of families of restoration: -1 Ezra 2:4 = Neh 7:9 ; Ezra 8:8 ; -2 2:57 = e. Benjamite 1Chr 9:8 . 2 יָהוּ -: a. son of Jehosh. 2Chr 21:2 . b. hero of David 1Chr 12:5 . c. Simeonite 1Chr 27:16 .
definitions.rootNote: or שְׁפַטְיָהוּ ; from 8199 and 3050 ; Jah has judged ;
